diagnostic_interpreter.purpose: Map evidence from a student's wrong answer to canonical skill + micro-skill + error type + confidence.

item_generator.purpose: Generate targeted variants from diagnosed micro-skills while preserving grade/track scope.

learning_map_recommender.purpose: Choose next-best skills from mastery evidence and prerequisite graph.

assessment_blueprint_builder.purpose: Build balanced self-test / worksheet blueprints from skills, difficulty and diagnostic intent.
